by the state duma beginning of document

this federal law, in accordance with the constitution of the russian federation, establishes the legal and organizational foundations of the state service system of the russian federation, including the system for managing state service in the russian federation. beginning of document

Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service

1. state service is subject to suspension in the cases provided for by point 2 of this article and by federal laws on the types of state service. article 12.1. procedure for suspending and resuming state service
1. State service is subject to suspension in the cases provided for by point 2 of this Article and by federal laws on the types of state service.

2. state service, other than military service, is suspended when a state servant is called up for military service under mobilization, is assigned to service in the national guard troops of the russian federation under mobilization, concludes a military service contract during a period of mobilization, martial law or wartime, or concludes a contract for voluntary assistance in carrying out tasks assigned to the armed forces of the russian federation or the national guard troops of the russian federation. article 12.1. procedure for suspending and resuming state service

2. State service, other than military service, is suspended when a state servant is called up for military service under mobilization, is assigned to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation under mobilization, concludes a military service contract during a period of mobilization, martial law or wartime, or concludes a contract for voluntary assistance in carrying out tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Fe
3. state service is suspended until the circumstances that constituted the grounds for its suspension cease to exist. article 12.1. procedure for suspending and resuming state service
3. State service is suspended until the circumstances that constituted the grounds for its suspension cease to exist.

the period of suspension of state service due to the circumstances provided for by point 2 of this article also includes the period from the day of completion of military service, service in the national guard troops of the russian federation under mobilization, or voluntary assistance in carrying out tasks assigned to the armed forces of the russian federation or the national guard troops of the russian federation, until the day of return to state service, but not more than three months, except in the case provided for by the third paragraph of this point. article 12.1. procedure for suspending and resuming state service

the time limit specified in the second paragraph of this point is extended by the period of the state servants temporary incapacity for work arising after completion of military service, service in the national guard troops of the russian federation under mobilization, or voluntary assistance in carrying out tasks assigned to the armed forces of the russian federation or the national guard troops of the russian federation. article 12.1. procedure for suspending and resuming state service
